story.fullStory:
James Gang's "Funk 49" reached #59 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Funk #49" is a song written by Joe Walsh, Jim Fox, and Dale Peters, and recorded by American hard rock band James Gang.

The song featured as the first single off the group's second studio album James Gang Rides Again (1970).

The song was a moderate success upon release, peaking at #59 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #59 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 10 weeks on the chart.
